query.commandtext: SELECT :program PROGRAM, NULL PS_SEQ, INSERT_TIME SETUP_TIMESIZE, INSERT_TIME LOAD_DATE, 0 SETUP_CNT, 0 BARS, 'ff6142' BIN_COLOR_DEFAULT, NULL CHIPOPTFILE, 0 CHUCKTEMP, NULL CODENAME, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X COLMAX, NULL CUSTOMER, 0 DEF_SUCCESS, MAPID DEVICE, 0 DIE_SUCCESS, TRUNC(ORIGIN_MICRO_X/1000,4) DIEOFFSET_X, TRUNC(ORIGIN_MICRO_Y/1000,4) DIEOFFSET_Y, TRUNC(CHIP_SIZE_X/1000,4) AS CHIP_SIZE_X, TRUNC(CHIP_SIZE_Y/1000,4) AS CHIP_SIZE_Y, TRUNC(EDGE_SIZE,4) AS EDGE_SIZE, 'ss' ESDA_MAP_DIRECTION, NULL ESDA_MAP_DIRECTORY, 1 ESDA_MAP_FILE, 'll' ESDA_MAP_ORIGIN, NULL ESDA_REMOTE_USER, NULL ESDA_MAP_SERVER, FACTORY FACILITY, 1 FULL_MAP_ON_ERROR, 'ff6142' INSP_COLOR_DEFAULT, 'FALSE' LASER_ALL_DIE, NULL LBE, NULL NBR, EDGE_SIZE NOTCHSIZE, 1 NUMRETICLES, 1 NUMSITES, 1 OVERWRITE_MAPFILE, NULL PERCENT_DCHK_INTERVAL, NULL PERCENT_DCHK_START, 0 PIN_ONE, NULL POSTPROCESS, NULL PROBER_MAP, 0 RCNUM, NULL RESET_SHIFTCHECK, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y ROWMAX, TRUNC(CHIP_SIZE_X/1000,4) STEPSIZE_X, TRUNC(CHIP_SIZE_Y/1000,4) STEPSIZE_Y, 'FALSE' TOTAL_DCHK_RESET, NULL USER_ID, CASE ANGLE WHEN 0 THEN 'Bottom' WHEN 90 THEN 'Left' WHEN 180 THEN 'Top' WHEN 270 THEN 'Right' END WAFERMAPROTATION, 0 X_REF_TOLERANCE, NVL(USER_REF_X, -((ORIGIN_INDEX_X - 1) * CHIP_SIZE_X + ORIGIN_MICRO_X - EDGE_SIZE*1000)/1000 ) AS X_REF_VECTOR , 0 Y_REF_TOLERANCE, NVL(USER_REF_Y, -((ORIGIN_INDEX_Y - 1) * CHIP_SIZE_Y + ORIGIN_MICRO_Y - 2*EDGE_SIZE*1000)/1000 ) AS Y_REF_VECTOR, 'INRULE' PROBE_SHIFT_DIE, 'FULL' BIN_SAMPLE_PLAN, 'FULL' PDL_SAMPLE_PLAN, NULL SHIP_GECBINS, WAFER_SIZE/1000 WAFER_SIZE FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE MAPID IN ( SELECT DEVICE_ALIAS FROM TQP_LOT WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND DEVICE_ALIAS <> 'NONE' )
